context: MCP calls the same RunRequest/RunPlan boundary the CLI uses; the security layer remains a pre-filter in front of it (allowlist -> validated options -> service). ClickHouse profile resolution stays MCP-side (server-config-owned secret material) but its OUTPUT feeds the service's standard option path rather than a private adapter-kwargs rewrite. Add a cross-surface equivalence test: for identical logical inputs, CLI and MCP produce the same resolved RunPlan (modulo surface metadata). Verify the statistics_benchmark_name subtlety survives via a characterization test before removing the special case.
description: PR #1692 routed ordinary MCP run_benchmark execution and durable benchmark jobs through benchbox/core/run_service.py, removed the former MCP-local mode, phase-type, and adapter-option translators, preserved surface-owned admission, tenancy, response envelopes, and durable publication, and verified execution-type parity across all 127 phase subsets. The original work order also required deleting _generate_data_impl where core covers data_only. A 2026-08-13 adversarial review confirmed that requirement remains incomplete: synchronous and durable mode=data_only still use the MCP-local generator. Successor mcp-adversarial-review-runtime-remediation-20260813 owns that remaining implementation plus real surface-level parity oracles. This done item now records the completed PR #1692 slice rather than asserting full data-only adoption.
